title: Diamond Elite Card: Getting Started with Your Elite Account
summary: This document explains how to activate and secure the Diamond Elite Card, set a PIN and transaction alerts, and review starting account terms: $495 annual fee (unless waived by an applicable promo), 15.99% Purchase APR, and a $32.50 late payment fee. It covers credit limit range ($37,500–$375,000), when to request a proactive limit review, AutoPay options to reduce interest, virtual card management (unique numbers, per-card limits, freeze/delete), access to elite concierge assistance, and a first-statement checklist to verify the posted $495 and credits/adjustments and confirm AutoPay.
faqs: How do I activate my Diamond Elite Card and secure it (PIN and transaction alerts)?
What are the Diamond Elite Card’s initial fees and APR (annual fee, Purchase APR, late fee) and when are they billed?
What credit limit will I start with, and can I request a proactive credit limit review after my first statement?
How should I set up AutoPay and choose statement balance vs total balance to minimize interest and avoid the $32.50 late fee?
Can I manage virtual cards on the Diamond Elite account (create unique numbers, set per-card limits, freeze/delete)?
What should I verify on my first statement (the $495 charge, credits/adjustments, payment due date, AutoPay setup)?
keywords: Virtual card management (unique numbers, per-card limits, freeze/delete)
